title: Steam's NextFest Needs A Bar For Slop; AI or Not
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
My game has been live on Steam for about 1 month, and being upfront it is 100% AI game, and its about over 1k prompts deep.

I was doing my social media marketing beforehand, when I put the Steam page up, I drove people to the Steam page and got wishlists; a high number of wishlist per day was 50 and a low of around 11 per day.

NextFest rolls around and the high goes up to 75, and then tapers off. I only had about 200 people play my demo during NextFest too.

NextFest has ended and even as I write this today, today current Wishlist count just for today is 60, so not far off from NextFest.

NextFest had marginal impact for my game's wishlist at best, and honestly I didn't really need the event to keep growing.

I think the fact that I only got like 200 demo plays is the most surprising. And I don't want to call a game made with AI inherently slop because being honest, there was slop before AI. AI has just made the problem worse.

There needs to be "quality bar" of NextFest of some sort, and I think it should apply to slop game in general, whether AI or not, because the amount of being released with no quality bar hurts all games.
